svg.aria-label: A 180-column row drawn to scale. The rendered row places the elapsed cell at column 125 and the clause at 133. The pre-fix test helper placed the elapsed cell at 121 and the clause at 129, four columns left, because the counter block it summed held three buckets where the row renders four.
svg.title: Derived column versus rendered column
svg.desc: The fixed region of a 180-column follower row is drawn to scale. The rendered row places the elapsed cell at column 125 and the clause at 133. The test helper that derives that column placed it at 125 minus the four columns of the queued bucket's two digits and letter plus its separator; the row renders four counter buckets on every row, so the helper read the elapsed cell and the clause four columns to the left of where the row places them.

g.text: A 180-column row: where the measure cell lands, and where the test helper read it
four columns: the queued bucket (2 digits + letter) and its separator,
rendered on every row and omitted from the helper's three-bucket sum
the row's elapsed cell, at column 125
where the helper read it, column 121
